validation.regression_triage: The first full run exposed an existing startup-test race reading the previous Host's running status. Preserved logs/database confirmed run.recovered and interrupted. The test now requires a new owner_id and a running OS lease; a regression assertion covers stale ownership. A PID-based intermediate test attempt was discarded because Windows venv launchers use a separate child PID. Final Host subset: 9 passed, 1 skipped. Final full suite passes.

boundaries: Explicit new attempts use the original input and current session context; this is not model-context continuation

Operator review is retained separately from physical receipts; unknown effects are never fabricated as successful

No generic MCP/shell/write retry safety or external exactly-once guarantee
Startup currently performs a full execution projection rebuild; no new snapshot/compaction scheme
All network and model probes use deterministic fixtures; no live Telegram messages or new configuration
